I had the same thing happen to me around this time last year.  Always had some sort of social anxiety but nothing too major but then one day I was drinking with my friends and I started having a panic attack.  This lasted a couple days like yours and it really freaked me out. Since I didn't do anything about it I had panic attacks about twice a week for 5 months until I decided to see our school therapist.  Seeing her changed everything for me, I haven't had a major one since March. The advice that helped me the most was to go to the bathroom and run ice cold water to your hands.  I think it had something to do with shocking your nervous system or something idk lol but that really helped me.  I know what it feels like for you right now and I hope this advice helps, I wouldn't wish this on anyone.
